style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: The Sanskrit word yugas reveals the immense scale of cosmic time
The phrase ahah ratrividah literally means knowers of day and night
Krishna defines true knowledge as knowing the vast duration of Brahma's day and night

angle_en: Ahah ratrividah: knowers of day and night
angle_hi: अहोरात्रविदो जनाः: दिन और रात को जानने वाले लोग

en.intro: Krishna describes the vast duration of Brahma's day and night. Listen for the word that measures this cosmic time.
en.notice: The phrase ahah ratrividah literally means knowers of day and night. In this verse, the phrase ahah ratrividah refers to the people who know the true length of Brahma's day and night, which is defined by the term yugas.
en.next: At the start of Brahma's day, all beings arise from the unmanifest, and at the start of Brahma's night, they dissolve back into that same unmanifest.
en.meaning: Those who know that Brahma’s day lasts a thousand yugas, and his night lasts a thousand yugas, know day and night truly.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ब्रह्मांडीय समय की विशाल अवधि का वर्णन करते हैं। इस शब्द को सुनिए जो इस ब्रह्मांडीय समय का माप बताता है।
hi.meaning: जो मनुष्य ब्रह्माके एक हज़ार चतुर्युगीवाले एक दिनको और सहस्त्र चतुर्युगीपर्यन्त एक रातको जानते हैं, वे मनुष्य ब्रह्माके दिन और रातको जाननेवाले हैं ॥
hi.notice: अहोरात्रविदो जनाः का अर्थ है दिन और रात को जानने वाले लोग। इस श्लोक में अहोरात्रविदो जनाः उन लोगों को दर्शाता है जो ब्रह्मा के दिन और रात की वास्तविक अवधि को जानते हैं, जिसे यॆगा शब्द से परिभाषित किया गया है।
hi.next: अगले श्लोक में, कृष्ण बताते हैं कि ब्रह्मा के दिन की शुरुआत में सभी प्राणी अव्यक्त से उत्पन्न होते हैं।

en.intro: Krishna describes the vast duration of Brahma's day and night. Listen for the word that measures this cosmic time.
en.body: Those who know that Brahma’s day lasts a thousand yugas, and his night lasts a thousand yugas, know day and night truly. The phrase ahah ratrividah literally means knowers of day and night. In this verse, the phrase ahah ratrividah refers to the people who know the true length of Brahma's day and night, which is defined by the term yugas. At the start of Brahma's day, all beings arise from the unmanifest, and at the start of Brahma's night, they dissolve back into that same unmanifest.
